summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Arcos Dorados Holdings Inc., a foreign private issuer, containing its unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports revenues of $1,215.963M, operating income of $62.764M, and net income attributable to the company of $36.141M. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes. No board actions, advisor appointments, or structural modifications are disclosed. The filing serves as a standard periodic financial report under the 1934 Act.
